source_text: In opposition, mainstream Islamic scholars and institutions, such as Dar al-Ifta and Al-Azhar, have declared FGM prohibited (haram) due to lack of explicit basis in the Quran and reliable Hadith, viewing it as a pre-Islamic tribal custom that violates the Islamic principle of no harm to the body.
